summary_for_children: Al-Inshiqaq speaks of the sky splitting in words, and swears by the twilight, the night and the full moon.
environment_concept: Evening: a band of twilight glow lingers on the horizon (84:16) as night gathers (84:17), and a large full moon rises (84:18). A row of eight stone discs shows the moon's phases, state after state (84:19). The splitting of the sky and the Day (84:1-15) are not pictured. No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: A low twilight glow on the horizon, a large rising full moon, a row of carved moon-phase stones, a bench.

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A caravan camp at the start of a long dry road through wide country to a town, with stone well-heads along the way

primary_mechanic.text: Plan the stops between wells at 0-90 km so no day is over 25 km and the town is reached in the fewest days (five); a too-long stage or a slower plan is refused with the reason. Then make camp at each chosen well in order while the sky goes from twilight glow, to night, to full moon, to the last of the night, to morning (84:16-19).

secondary_activities: a reward that never ends (84:25, read)
unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading at the camp, planning, five stages of travel, then a reading at the town gate
environment_behaviour: the sky changes stage by stage
camp fires glow at wells where you camped
unique_world.learning_objective: Know the oath that we travel from stage to stage (84:16-19)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Journey of Life
story_library.children_narration: Surah Al-Inshiqaq describes the coming Day of Judgment and reminds us that human beings are traveling toward their Lord. Every person works through life's difficulties and choices, and our actions have meaning.

world_idea.title: The Journey Through Time
world_idea.description: A symbolic landscape that changes as the player moves forward, with reflective activities connected to responsibility and perseverance.
